pages.title: Bighorn Sheep
pages.text: The bighorn sheep ($(o)Ovis canadensis$()) is a wild sheep of the mountains and deserts of western North America.$(br2)Rams have massive curled horns, and during the rut they charge each other head-on at high speed, with clashes heard far away.$(br2)Bighorns have a white rump and muzzle, and climb steep cliffs to escape predators.
